description: This file is a Go source file defining utility functions and data structures for managing directory paths used by the AgentField project. It includes functions to determine directory paths based on environment variables and platform specifics, create necessary directories with appropriate permissions, and validate path accessibility.

classes.name: DataDirectories
classes.description: A struct holding paths to various data directories used by the AgentField application.

methods.name: GetAgentFieldDataDirectories
methods.description: Returns the paths to all standard directories used by AgentField, respecting environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: EnsureDataDirectories
methods.description: Creates all necessary directories with appropriate permissions, including handling sensitive directories.

methods.name: GetDatabasePath
methods.description: Provides the full path to the main agent field database file.

methods.name: GetKVStorePath
methods.description: Returns the path for the key-value store database file.

methods.name: GetAgentRegistryPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the agent registry JSON file.

methods.name: GetConfigPath
methods.description: Generates a path for a configuration file given its filename.

methods.name: GetLogPath
methods.description: Generates a path for a log file given its filename.

methods.name: GetTempPath
methods.description: Generates a path for a temporary file given its filename.

methods.name: GetPlatformSpecificPaths
methods.description: Returns platform-specific paths based on the operating system.

methods.name: ValidatePaths
methods.description: Checks if the application can write to the main data directory, validating path accessibility.
